timeline.summary: Mahendrakumar Rameshwarlal Kabra, as Promoter, declared no encumbrances on promoter group shares by March 31, 2026, listing 49 entities including Rameshwarlal Kabra and R R Kabel Limited.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,752.85 Cr (+83.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹39.01 Cr (includes ₹1.38 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹40.61 Cr).
Ram Ratna Wires released its FY26 investor presentation reporting consolidated revenue of ₹5,176.6 Cr and a PAT of ₹108.6 Cr.
Ram Ratna Wires reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹1,934.47 Cr and PAT of ₹28.88 Cr, and approved acquiring the remaining 50% stake in Epavo Electricals.
CARE Ratings revised Ram Ratna Wires' long-term bank facilities outlook to Positive from Stable (rating CARE A- / CARE A2+).
